candidates.name: Intussusception
support_spans: small-bowel obstruction at the terminal ileum
lobulated tubular soft tissue and inflammation adjacent to the terminal ileum/ileocecal valve
candidates.why: The imaging findings of small-bowel obstruction and lobulated tubular soft tissue are consistent with intussusception, which can be a cause of intestinal obstruction.
candidates.protected_reason: Intussusception is a rare cause of intestinal obstruction in adults and may be easily missed, making it a candidate for minority protection.

candidates.protected_reason: GIST is a rare tumor that can be easily missed, and its diagnosis requires a high index of suspicion, making it a candidate for minority protection.
